name: Shared Rules Injector
description: Injects a single shared markdown file into the agent system prompt on every turn via the `before_prompt_build` hook. Replaces the pattern of duplicating identical rule blocks across every AGENTS.md. The injection uses `appendSystemContext` so providers can cache it.

file.description: Path to the shared rules markdown file, relative to workspaceRoot (or absolute). Default 'shared/core-rules.md'.

skipAgents.description: Agent IDs to exclude from injection.

onlyAgents.description: If set, only inject for these agent IDs. Mutually exclusive with skipAgents (onlyAgents takes precedence).

mode.description: 'everyTurn' injects on every before_prompt_build call (default, cached). 'firstTurn' injects only when the session has no prior messages.

workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path to workspace root. Only needed if the host does not supply one.
